scope: Newtonian ideal-gas Cartesian hydro, uniform 2D mesh, existing lagrangian_mc mass-flux tracer; AMR/additional physics excluded

accepted_engineering_criteria.uniform_particles: all exact IDs retained; each resolved positive-axis periodic hop is zero or exactly one cell
accepted_engineering_criteria.uniform_moments: fixed-seed ensemble mean and unbiased variance each within six predeclared standard errors of independent Bernoulli physical-flux oracle
accepted_engineering_criteria.fixed_seed_noninterference: on/off thermo observations and selected fluid conserved-variable output exactly identical at same partition
accepted_engineering_criteria.restart: exact same-partition particle observations, schedule-derived IDs and canonical event identity/content continuation; no repartition assertion
accepted_engineering_criteria.migration: local four-block case retains all IDs and exercises GID changes; no identical initial seed draw assignment required across different partitions
accepted_engineering_criteria.event_structure: strict schema/count/END and unique (lineage, particleID, sequence); no duplicate generation sampling; complete suspended/censored evidence
accepted_engineering_criteria.zero_particles: success with empty outputs, no inferred events
accepted_engineering_criteria.overflow: burst above finite capacity rejects explicitly without silent dropped events
accepted_engineering_criteria.checkpoint_integrity: missing/corrupt/future sidecar and corrupt committed history reject; paired output preflight preserves existing bytes

uniform_oracle.probability: p_n = u*dt_n/dx; use recorded generation times, not copied RNG code
uniform_oracle.limits: fixed hash draws are tested as an independent Bernoulli ensemble; no deterministic physical path, no GPU or multirank claim

planar_shock.seeding: 128 mass-weighted tracers in upstream slab .45-.75; initial inside and delayed birth separate fixtures
planar_shock.measurements: empirical full-region recovery, unique particles, completed/partial/suspended counts, reentry episodes, endpoint normal/strength evidence; no forced one event for every ideal deterministic crossing
planar_shock.physical_approval: pending owner criteria for stochastic recovery and scientific strength/timing interpretation

phase_checkpoints: select actual observed OUTSIDE/ACTIVE/PENDING generations; inability to populate any phase remains an explicit failed fixture
deployment: Rusty node and Frontier backend/scale/performance budgets unset; both unqualified
status: criteria frozen before any MC runtime outcomes
